repair.content:
Restrict comparison and consequent invariance claims to proved fixed-class scope, or define/prove precise sl2/mod2 or all-integer gl2 construction.

Add nonemptiness to filteredness and I filtered to lemma, or full comma-category criterion.

Use Kar(C) or assume idempotent completeness.

Reverse inequality, use correct object indices and K[z] x K[z] with z_n^(n+1).

Use sum q^-2n(omega+omega); Y_n=q^-2n omega'_(i+j).

Restore both normalization factors.

Exclude/qualify equality and correct arrow U_(l-2); strict inequality not independently proved here.
